tools.description: List employees (従業員) of the SmartHR tenant, with filters: free-text name/department/position search, status (employed, absent, retired), employee number, employment type, department, position, hire and resignation date ranges. Returns a compact record per employee; use `fields` for more. Sensitive d

tools.name: smarthr_get_employee
tools.description: Get one employee (従業員) by id. Returns a compact record; use `fields` for more (address, phone, birth date, custom fields, contract dates). Sensitive data is never returned.

tools.name: smarthr_list_dependents
tools.description: List the dependents (家族情報) registered for one employee: name, relation, birth date, living arrangement and support status. Pension numbers, income and documents are not returned.

tools.name: smarthr_list_maternity_childcare_leaves
tools.description: List the maternity and childcare leave records (産休育休) of one employee: expected birth, leave start/end and scheduled return dates. Bank, insurance and memo data are not returned.

tools.name: smarthr_list_departments
tools.description: List departments (部署) with their hierarchy (parent, children), code and company.

tools.name: smarthr_get_department
tools.description: Get one department (部署) by id, with its parent and children.

tools.name: smarthr_list_positions
tools.description: List positions / job titles (役職) with their rank and code.

tools.name: smarthr_list_employment_types
tools.description: List employment types (雇用形態), e.g. full-timer, part-timer, contract worker, with their ids for filtering and writes.

tools.name: smarthr_list_grades
tools.description: List grades (等級) with their rank.

tools.name: smarthr_list_job_categories
tools.description: List job categories (職種).

tools.name: smarthr_list_companies
tools.description: List the companies (会社) of the tenant: name, code, corporate number, address, phone.

tools.name: smarthr_list_business_establishments
tools.description: List business establishments (事業所): name, social insurance and labor insurance registration data, company.

tools.name: smarthr_list_employee_custom_fields
tools.description: List the definitions of the tenant's custom employee fields (カスタム従業員項目): name, type and, for dropdowns, the choices. Use them to read the values in custom_fields.

tools.name: smarthr_list_dependent_relations
tools.description: List the relation types for dependents (続柄: spouse, child, parent...) with their ids, needed by smarthr_create_dependent.

tools.name: smarthr_list_users
tools.description: List SmartHR users (login accounts): email, administrator flag, role, linked employee, and the invitation status (created, opened, accepted, answered). Use it to find the administrator id for smarthr_invite_employee.

tools.name: smarthr_list_employee_input_forms
tools.description: List the employee information collection forms (従業員情報収集フォーム) that an invitation can use.

tools.name: smarthr_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the configured webhooks (target URL, which employee and dependent events notify). Read-only; secret tokens and the query string of the target URL are never shown.

tools.name: smarthr_create_employee
tools.description: WRITE: Register a new employee (従業員) in SmartHR. Nothing is sent to the employee; to invite them to fill in their own data use smarthr_invite_employee afterwards. Only the fields you give are set. The tenant plan may cap the number of employees (error plan_limit_exceeded). Returns the created employ

tools.name: smarthr_update_employee
tools.description: WRITE: Change fields of one existing employee (partial update: only the fields you give change; others stay). Typical uses: set the status to absent or retired with the resignation date, correct a name, email or phone, move the employee to other departments (department_ids replaces the current list)

tools.name: smarthr_create_department
tools.description: WRITE: Create a department (部署). Give the parent department id to nest it. Returns the created department.

tools.name: smarthr_update_department
tools.description: WRITE: Rename or move one department (partial update: only the fields you give change). Returns the updated department.

tools.name: smarthr_create_dependent
tools.description: WRITE: Register a dependent (家族情報) for an employee. Needs the relation id from smarthr_list_dependent_relations. Returns the created dependent without pension number, income or documents.

tools.name: smarthr_invite_employee
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS AN EMAIL: Invite an employee to SmartHR. SmartHR emails the address stored on the employee (the employee must have one) an invitation to create their login and, with an input form, to fill in their own data. findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "smarthr_list_departments" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "smarthr_list_webhooks" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List the configured webhooks (target URL, which employee and dependent events notify). Read-only; secret tokens and the query string of the target URL are never…

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "smarthr_invite_employee" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: WRITE, SENDS AN EMAIL: Invite an employee to SmartHR. SmartHR emails the address stored on the employee (the employee must have one) an invitation to create the…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: smarthr_list_users, smarthr_list_webhooks, smarthr_update_employee · Private data: smarthr_list_employees, smarthr_get_employee, smarthr_list_dependents, smarthr_list_maternity_childcare_leaves, smarthr_list_webhooks, smarthr_create_employee, smarthr_update_employee, smarthr_create_dependent · Public sink: smarthr_list_users, smarthr_list_webhooks, smarthr_update_employee, smarthr_invite_employee.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: smarthr_list_users, smarthr_list_webhooks, smarthr_update_employee · Private data: smarthr_list_employees, smarthr_get_employee, smarthr_list_dependents, smarthr_list_maternity_childcare_leaves, smarthr_list_webhooks, smarthr_create_employee, smarthr_update_employee, smarthr_create_dependent · Public sink: smarthr_list_users, smarthr_list_webhooks, smarthr_update_employee, smarthr_invite_employee

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
